title: Coefficient and proper comparison squares for relative-product factors
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, integers $a,n\geq1$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_{p^a}$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and a uniformizer $\varpi_E$. Put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, choose $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$, and fix the six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] for these parameters. Integral pullbacks and tensors are completed; field coefficients use rationalization and a common finite coefficient field. Let $B$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, let $f:X\to B$ and $g:Y\to B$ be separated finite-type morphisms, and let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$. Write $T=X\times_BY$, $u:T\to X$, $v:T\to Y$, $h=fu=gv$, $P=Lu^*K$, $Q=Rf_!K$ and $H=P\otimes^L_\Lambda Lv^*L$. Define the following objects of $D^b_{ctf}(B,\Lambda)$:
$$\begin{aligned}
D_0&=Rh_!H,&D_1&=Rg_!Rv_!H,\\
D_2&=Rg_!(Rv_!P\otimes^L L),&D_3&=Rg_!(Lg^*Q\otimes^L L),\\
D_4&=Rg_!(L\otimes^L Lg^*Q),&D_5&=Rg_!L\otimes^L Q,\\
D_6&=Q\otimes^L Rg_!L.
\end{aligned}$$
Let $d_i:D_i\to D_{i+1}$, for $0\leq i<6$, be, in order,
$$\alpha_{g,v,H}^{-1},\quad Rg_!(\operatorname{PF}_{v,P,L}^{-1}),\quad Rg_!(\operatorname{Ex}_{!,K}^{-1}\otimes1_L),\quad Rg_!(\sigma_{Lg^*Q,L}),\quad\operatorname{PF}_{g,L,Q}^{-1},\quad\sigma_{Rg_!L,Q}.$$
Here $\alpha$ is the supplied composition comparison (A4), $\operatorname{Ex}_{!,K}:Lg^*Rf_!K\to Rv_!Lu^*K$ is (A2) for $(u,v,f,g)$, $\operatorname{PF}$ is [def-sf-pf], and $\sigma$ is tensor symmetry. Each $d_i$ is natural in both $K$ and $L$. Let $C$ be an admissible coefficient comparison: a derived finite reduction at a finite or integral stage, rationalization from $\mathcal O_E$ to $E$, or scalar extension through a finite coefficient extension or into $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ at a common finite field. Denote the changed objects and factors by $D_i^C,d_i^C$, and let $c_i:C_B(D_i)\xrightarrow{\sim}D_i^C$ be the canonical comparisons obtained by applying the datum's coefficient comparisons to the displayed operations. For every $0\leq i<6$ the individual factor square commutes:
$$c_{i+1}\circ C_B(d_i)=d_i^C\circ c_i.$$
For every proper structural morphism among $f,g,v,h$, replace its compact-support functor by the direct image through the specified proper identification. Each $d_i$ is identified with the corresponding proper-normalized factor. In particular, when $f$ is proper, so is $v$, and the exchange factor is the inverse of the specified proper-base-change exchange; at finite coefficients the proper identification has the identity-open normalization. Projection factors agree with the direct-image projection factors whenever their morphism is proper. These factor identifications respect the same coefficient comparisons.

lean.statement: theorem relative_product_coefficient_factor_squares {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum} {E E' : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] [Field E'] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E'] [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E'] {n n' : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n} {hn' : 1 ≤ n'} {S : SixFunctorDatum D C E n hn} {S' : SixFunctorDatum D C E' n' hn'} {s s' : PodCoefficientStage} {Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D} [IsSeparated Q.Y.obj.hom] [IsSeparated Q.f.hom.left] [IsSeparated Q.g.hom.left] [IsSeparated Q.g'.hom.left] [IsSeparated Q.f'.hom.left] (R : RelativeProductPresentation S s Q) (R' : RelativeProductPresentation S' s' Q) (A : RelativeProductCoefficientData R R') (_admissible : A.RecordedComparison) (cg : Compactification Q.g.hom.left) (ch : Compactification (Q.f' ≫ Q.g).hom.left) : A.FactorSquares cg ch ∧ (∀ (i : Fin 6) K K' L L' (a : K ⟶ K') (b : L ⟶ L'), ((relativeProductTerms Q cg ch i.castSucc).eval R.coordinates.operations R.coordinates.tensor).map (Prod.mkHom a b) ≫ (R.factors cg ch i).hom.app (K', L') = (R.factors cg ch i).hom.app (K, L) ≫ ((relativeProductTerms Q cg ch i.succ).eval R.coordinates.operations R.coordinates.tensor).map (Prod.mkHom a b)) ∧ Nonempty (RelativeProductProperCoordinates R.coordinates) ∧ Nonempty (RelativeProductProperCoordinates R'.coordinates) ∧ (∀ (J : RelativeProductProperCoordinates R.coordinates) (J' : RelativeProductProperCoordinates R'.coordinates), R.ProperNormalization J ∧ R'.ProperNormalization J' ∧ A.ProperComparisonNormalization J J' ∧ A.ProperFactorSquares J J' cg ch)
